description: Flat record-level metadata schema for metagenome-assembled genomes derived from marine microbial communities, including environmental sampling context, processing, sequencing, assembly, and quality assessment fields.

record_id.descr: Unique identifier for the MAG metadata record or genome bin within the dataset.

sample_id.descr: Identifier of the environmental sample from which the MAG was recovered.

collection_site_name.descr: Name of the marine collection site, station, cruise location, or sampling point.

latitude.descr: Latitude of the sampling location in decimal degrees (WGS84).

longitude.descr: Longitude of the sampling location in decimal degrees (WGS84).

ocean_region.descr: Broad marine region or basin, for example North Atlantic, South Pacific, Mediterranean Sea.

collection_date.descr: Date of sample collection in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

ocean_depth_m.descr: Sampling depth in meters below sea surface.

depth_zone.descr: Categorical depth zone, for example surface, epipelagic, mesopelagic, bathypelagic, abyssopelagic.

water_temperature_c.descr: In situ water temperature in degrees Celsius at the time of sampling.

salinity_psu.descr: In situ salinity in practical salinity units (PSU).

ph.descr: In situ pH of the sampled water column.

dissolved_oxygen_mg_l.descr: Dissolved oxygen concentration in milligrams per liter (mg/L).

nutrient_conditions.descr: Brief categorical or textual description of relevant nutrient status, for example oligotrophic, mesotrophic, eutrophic, or measured nutrient profile summary.

sample_habitat.descr: Marine habitat or sampling context, for example open ocean, coastal water, estuary, deep sea, hydrothermal plume.

cell_disruption_chemical_method.descr: Chemical cell disruption or lysis method used during DNA extraction, for example SDS, lysozyme, proteinase K, bead-compatible chemical lysis.

cell_disruption_mechanical_method.descr: Mechanical disruption method used during DNA extraction, for example bead beating, sonication, French press, homogenization.

dna_extraction_protocol.descr: DNA extraction kit, protocol name, or laboratory method used to recover DNA from the marine sample.

library_prep_method.descr: Sequencing library preparation protocol or kit used.

sequencing_platform.descr: Sequencing platform used, for example Illumina NovaSeq, Illumina HiSeq, PacBio Sequel II, Oxford Nanopore PromethION.

sequencing_read_type.descr: Read configuration used for sequencing, for example single-end, paired-end, long-read, hybrid.

read_length_bp.descr: Primary read length in base pairs for short-read sequencing, or typical read length if applicable.

insert_size_bp.descr: Approximate library insert size in base pairs, if applicable.

sequencing_depth_gbp.descr: Total sequencing output assigned to the sample or MAG in gigabase pairs (Gbp).

assembler_name.descr: Genome assembly software used, for example metaSPAdes, MEGAHIT, Flye, SPAdes.

assembler_version.descr: Version of the assembly software used.

assembly_strategy.descr: Assembly strategy used, for example single-sample metagenome, co-assembly, hybrid assembly.

binning_method.descr: Method or software used to recover the genome bin, if applicable, for example MetaBAT2, CONCOCT, MaxBin2, manual curation.

quality_assessment_software.descr: Software used to assess MAG quality, completeness, contamination, or refinement.

quality_assessment_version.descr: Version of the quality assessment software.

completeness_percent.descr: Estimated genome completeness expressed as a percentage (0-100).

contamination_percent.descr: Estimated genome contamination expressed as a percentage (0-100).

genome_quality_category.descr: Overall MAG quality category, for example high-quality, medium-quality, low-quality, based on the study's criteria.

genome_size_bp.descr: Estimated assembled genome size in base pairs.

gc_content_percent.descr: GC content of the assembled genome expressed as a percentage.

contig_count.descr: Number of contigs/scaffolds in the MAG assembly.

taxonomy_assignment.descr: Taxonomic classification assigned to the MAG, ideally using a standardized taxonomy string.

taxonomic_assignment_method.descr: Method or database used for taxonomic assignment, for example GTDB-Tk, Kraken2, SILVA, NCBI taxonomy.

ecological_role_inference.descr: Optional interpretation of the inferred ecological role, for example carbon cycling, nitrogen cycling, sulfur oxidation, symbiosis.

notes.descr: Additional free-text notes relevant to this MAG record, including unusual processing or assembly details.
